content.short: Q Blockchain is an EVM-compatible L1 chain for DeFi and decentralized governance.
content.description: Q Blockchain is an EVM-compatible Layer 1 network focused on DeFi and decentralized governance. It features a Layer 0 legal layer for root nodes that oversee consensus on Layer 1, a user-facing legal constitution, and token rewards that cover gas fees for holders of Q. The network runs 5-second blocks and blends delegated proof-of-stake with a POA-like model, supported by more than 100 validators and 25 root nodes. Built to operate across Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, and other compatible networks, it enables diverse deployments and interactions within a multichain ecosystem.
